newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico may make another pre-payment to IMF--report.
newsitem.headline: Mexico may make another pre-payment to IMF--report.

text.p: Mexico plans to pre-pay another $300 million in loans to the International Monetary Fund in the coming days, the Mexico City newspaper El Financiero reported Friday.
Finance Ministry officials were not available for comment on the report.
The newspaper quoted unnamed sources in New York as saying Mexico would make the payment using money from a 100 billion yen Samurai bond issue earlier this month.
Analysts say Mexico has been keen to place international long-term debt while conditions are good and use the money to draw down debt with the IMF.
Mexico has already paid back the United States in full for some $12.5 billion in emergency loans following the 1994-95 peso crisis.
In January Mexico pre-paid some $1.5 billion to the IMF and in February pre-paid another $590 million.
El Financiero said Mexico still owes roughly $11.3 billion to the IMF.
